local (turion_jev.serve) turion-jev · effort not in the requests

A late entry joins an original league table after it was played and plays every setup of that table once, in matches of its own. Its games count in no standings table, no league table, no Hype Cup input and no other setup's numbers. The numbers here come from its own late-entry games only, computed as for a setup in a league.

Error rate and risk judgement: 95% intervals, whole games resampled. Ability d′ and caution c at the 0.001 margin: rates corrected by adding 0.5 to the counts and 1 to the totals; 95% intervals, blocks of two seat-swapped games resampled. Cut off: answers that stopped at an output limit the request sent (finish reason length, stop reason max_tokens, finishReason MAX_TOKENS, incomplete max_output_tokens), in the stored response or error. Effort: the reasoning effort the requests sent. Engine's best play: the share of its scored decisions that chose the engine's best play (equity loss under the best-play threshold). Time: median request seconds per decision (waits between retries not included). Cost per 1,000 decisions: the recorded tokens at the price shown, as labelled there (list or billed price; for a setup on our GPUs the hosted model's list price, not billed).

blocks.p: our GPU (NVIDIA DGX Spark, GB10, spark2), FP8 at load, through the server its package ships (python -m turion_jev.serve, vLLM 0.32.0 in process, --quantization fp8 --no-recheck), one request at a time
no price per token; estimate: GPU time, at most; source content/own_cost.json (wall clock on our machines × hourly rate); price date not recorded
up to 255 options per request; more legal plays are split into equal groups, a winner per group, then among the winners; no decision in this data was split

Late entry to the original League 1 table (not in standings, not eligible for the Hype Cup), late-entry league #46. turion-ai/turion-jev-31b @ 866c0fc on our DGX Spark (spark2, the whole GB10, handed over by logic one server at a time), FP8 at load, through the server its package ships (python -m turion_jev.serve, vLLM 0.32.0 in process, --quantization fp8 --no-recheck), one request at a time; never on a hosted API. First stage 13 Nov 2026: its 9 hosted and program opponents (#1241–#1249, runner a127626 for #1241, then a72223d); local stage 14 Nov 2026: the 8 setups we run ourselves, one at a time on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell of ours (#1403–#1410, runner 2a22d1f). It played 17 of its 19 opponents: its pair with Mercury Decide was not played (Mercury Decide is no longer served on OpenRouter; match #1250 aborted at its warm-up; outside the requested scope, Ümit, 12 Nov) and its pair with GPT-6 Luna was not played (GPT-6 Luna's API was out of credit; outside the requested scope, Ümit, 12 Nov). BF16 weights quantised to FP8 at load and re-scoring off (--no-recheck), as in the card's run; probabilities rounded to 6 places. Its server was stopped after an OOM kill on spark2 (13 Nov 12:33 UTC, 3 failed health checks); from 14:29 UTC it ran through logic's launcher turion_serve_headroom.py --gpu-mem 0.80 (logic #6191), which sets only vLLM's memory share (the KV cache size) and then runs turion_jev.serve unchanged, pinned by its sha256. Never truncates: a prompt over 65,536 tokens is refused (422); nothing refused. Its cost is an estimate from its time on the DGX Spark (GPU time, at most).
